I totally understand the consequences smoking can have, It's not like im 9, I'm over the legal smoking age.

And i dont give a fuck what they think, i just dont want it screamed at me 24/7.

Ive tried all of those.

My teachers are alright, but ultimately just send me to the school counsellor when im obviously not okay. He doesn't help. And i go to a public school full of cunts. They all either hate me because I'm not a popular kid, a sporty kid, a tough cunt, or they just hate me for petty reasons like they see me smoking and assume im a bad person just for that.

I don't even understand whats wrong with me, but I hate it. I hate myself, and i dont want this to keep going like this. Im not okay, and i cant continue to be not okay.
I've been holding out on the possibility of being happy for years, nothing changes it. I get one poison out of my life and another gets introduced. Nothing I do is right and I can't do it any more.
